league._comment: Per-iteration worker mix at level 2: scripted_slots workers vs scripted/expert, latest_slots vs current opponent, remainder vs ghosts sampled over full history. scripted_slots raised to 3 so neither side can overfit to a collapsed opponent — both keep facing agents that play the real game.

pfsp._comment: Prioritized Fictitious Self-Play (AlphaStar). Ghost slots are drawn with weight f_hard(1 - win_rate) = (1 - win_rate)^p instead of uniformly, concentrating training on opponents we actually lose to. Exploitability showed the defender under-responds to the attacker (gap 0.25 vs 0.11), which is exactly the gap this targets. Opponents with fewer than min_games recorded keep the uniform weight so a single unlucky episode cannot dominate sampling.
pfsp._comment_enabled: Set true to train with PFSP; false reproduces the uniform league for the before/after comparison.

llm._comment_enabled: Set to true once you have an API key configured
llm._comment_model_gemini: Free tier. Set GEMINI_API_KEY env var.
llm._comment_model_ollama: For CodeLlama via Ollama: set provider=ollama, model=codellama
llm._comment_model_ollama2: Make sure ollama is running: ollama serve && ollama pull codellama
llm._comment_api_key: Gemini: set GEMINI_API_KEY env var. Anthropic: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Or paste key here.
llm._comment_consult_prob: Fraction of steps where LLM is queried (cost/rate control)

wandb._comment: Weights & Biases logging, off by default and a no-op if the package is absent. Needed to compare arms across a multi-seed sweep: per-iteration win rates, Elo, strategy entropy, curriculum level and the PFSP sampling distribution. Install with `pip install wandb` (already listed, commented, in requirements.txt).
